defects.title: Never fabricate rental status/type
defects.issue: lib/server/rental/merge.ts defaulted unknown/unparseable raw availability to "Còn trống" and unknown propertyType to "Nhà"; WEB_BDS_CUSTOM records went through an equivalent coerce-to-default. Violated the contract's no-fabrication rule and could publish a listing with an invented status.
defects.fix: AdminPropertyRecord.propertyType/availability are now PropertyType|null / Availability|null (public PropertyListing stays guaranteed non-null — only the admin-visible shape can be 'unknown'). Every default fallback removed. A single isEligibleToPublish() gate (price>0, area>0, availability non-null, propertyType non-null) is applied AFTER any override patch is merged in, so an admin setting published:true can no longer force a record public without actually fixing the underlying fields. coercePropertyType/coerceAvailability now return null on an unrecognized value instead of a default. app/actions/bds.ts validates admin-typed propertyType/availability against the real union (reusing lib/server/rental/parse.ts's parsePropertyType/parseAvailability) and rejects a mismatch as a field error rather than ever storing it.
defects.testsAdded: 5 tests in rentalMerge.test.ts (unknown availability doesn't publish and isn't coerced; unknown propertyType doesn't publish and isn't coerced; a valid override patch makes a record eligible; published:true alone does NOT make it eligible without a real value; an invalid custom-record propertyType is never coerced to "Nhà"), 1 test in bdsActions.test.ts (invalid propertyType/availability text is rejected with field errors).

defects.title: Ambiguous bare decimal price
defects.issue: parsePriceVnd("2,8") returned 28 — silently treating the comma as a thousands separator. The real production sheet contains this exact shape at rows 16 and 21 (verified by ChatGPT); guessing it means 2.8 triệu (or anything else) violates the no-fabrication rule.
defects.fix: Outside the explicit "triệu"/"tr" unit path, parsePriceVnd now only accepts a bare digit string ("8000000") or a properly thousands-grouped number ("12.000.000", "6.500.000" — every group after the first separator exactly 3 digits, either "." or "," as the grouping character). Any other separator shape ("2,8", "3,2", "5,5") returns null.
defects.testsAdded: 3 new cases in rentalParse.test.ts's parsePriceVnd suite using the exact reported shapes, plus a "6.500.000" unambiguous-grouped case.

defects.title: productionDemoContentForbiddenByDefault
defects.issue: Every provider factory (rental/projects/news/media/contact) fell back to the GĐ4/GĐ5 fixture or a throwaway in-memory store whenever Google config was absent, with no distinction between "local/test" and "real production deploy missing its config". A real production deploy without secrets would have silently served fixture listings as real content, and contact/media writes would have reported success into a store that's gone on the next request.
defects.fix: One shared decision point, lib/server/providerMode.ts: resolveProviderMode(isConfigured) returns "live" when configured; "mock" when NODE_ENV=test, VITEST=true, or NODE_ENV!=="production" (test runs and local dev); otherwise "unavailable". Every domain's fixture-seeding now only runs in "mock" mode — "unavailable" leaves the in-memory store empty, so reads (public and Admin) come back empty rather than presenting demo content as real. Every mutation action (saveBdsAction/hideBdsSourceRecordAction/deleteCustomBdsRecordAction, saveProjectAction/deleteProjectAction, saveNewsAction/deleteNewsAction, uploadMediaAction/deleteMediaAction, submitContactAction) now checks the mode before touching the repository and returns PERSISTENCE_NOT_CONFIGURED_ERROR (or contact's existing generic failure) instead of a fake success.
defects.operationalNote: `next start` sets NODE_ENV=production even for local/manual QA — by design, that now correctly resolves to "unavailable" without Google config, matching a real deployment. Local QA that needs fixture/mock data must use `next dev` (NODE_ENV=development) instead; this session's e2e regression run was switched to `next dev` accordingly.
defects.testsAdded: 5 tests in providerMode.test.ts (the full NODE_ENV/VITEST decision matrix) + 9 tests in productionWithoutConfig.test.ts (rental/projects/news public reads empty, all five domains' mutation actions fail closed, and a control test confirming NODE_ENV=test/local-dev is unaffected).

e2eHarness.background: After the GĐ6 visual QA reopen fix (237431c19), tests/e2e (16 specs) split 3 pass / 13 fail against `next start` with no secrets. A git-stash before/after comparison proved the 13 failures were identical on the unmodified pre-visual-fix baseline — a pre-existing runtime-mode mismatch, not a defect: those specs all assume fixture data + working admin credentials (lib/server/providerMode.ts's "mock" mode, or the env-gated admin auth), neither of which `next start` without secrets ever provides (by design — see qaReopens[0].defects[2]). The fix was to stop running one mixed-runtime suite and instead give each runtime its own explicit, self-contained Playwright config/npm script.

mediaStatus.detail: WEB_MEDIA catalog repository + a separate blob-store abstraction (Google Drive vs. in-memory), MIME/size validation, real upload/delete Server Actions, and a public delivery proxy (/api/media/[id]) that never exposes the service-account credential. Legacy raw-sheet Drive/Photos hyperlink resolution falls back to a placeholder + diagnostic, never fails the whole listing. uploadMediaAction/deleteMediaAction now refuse with a config error in production without Drive configured (QA reopen defect 03) instead of reporting a fake durable success. A real cross-bundle singleton-splitting bug (uploads invisible to the separately-bundled delivery Route Handler) was found via live e2e testing and fixed by anchoring the in-memory singleton on globalThis.
mediaStatus.knownLimitation: Legacy media resolution has per-process memoization but no batch pre-resolve or persistent cache — the real ~1,102-row sheet would need that before production traffic once Google credentials are live.

contactStatus.detail: ContactForm UI unchanged; submits through a real Server Action into WEB_CONTACTS. Server-side validation is authoritative, honeypot added without altering the approved layout (pixel-identical to baseline). Client IP is never stored raw — only an HMAC-SHA256 hash — with a two-layer rate limit conservatively capped at 3 submissions per hashed IP per 10 minutes. submitContactAction now returns the existing generic failure (never ok:true) in production without config (QA reopen defect 03). No Admin Leads/Viewing UI added, per contract.

authStatus.detail: Real single-admin session auth replacing the GĐ4 localStorage mock: scrypt password hashing, HMAC-signed session cookie, proxy.ts doing optimistic presence-only redirects, real re-verification at the DAL on every protected request. Verified live: unauthenticated redirect, wrong password, correct login surviving a hard reload, HttpOnly+SameSite cookie flags, logout, a deliberately tampered cookie being rejected server-side, and remember-me expiry — all 7 cases are permanent Playwright specs in tests/e2e/admin-auth.spec.ts.

securityStatus.detail: tests/unit/server/dataLeak.test.ts (15 tests) covers unauthenticated-mutation rejection, public DTO field-stripping, unpublished-record unreachability, no-secret-echo in error messages, and the raw rental source's single read-only method. Media MIME/size validation, rental parser quarantine behavior, and the QA-reopen-fixed fabrication/production-fail-closed behaviors are covered in their own task/fix test files. A green suite is one input, not proof of security on its own — no external/adversarial security review has been performed.
